intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (177.8 km)

story: The Stage 1 of PostNord Tour of Denmark saw a late breakaway of five riders caught 70 km out after the peloton accelerated. A significant crash split the peloton, but it regrouped before the local circuit where six riders escaped. Wout van Aert bridged to the front on the final climb with Søren Kragh Andersen, and won the sprint ahead of Lukáš Kubiš and Henrik Pedersen.
